purpose: Tier classification of the 398 published articles whose BODY carries a testing claim (S1 old+new union, merged-gate parity #483). Read-only analysis — no body text is modified.

methodology.patterns: active S1 (#480) + proposed S1 (#483 wired) + report-only first-person patterns (task-4 set)
methodology.affected_words: words on claim lines + words in a 'How We/I Tested' methodology section when present
methodology.marked_paragraph_lines: distinct body lines carrying >= 1 claim sentence
methodology.inbound_links: distinct published articles linking to the article (task-G convention)
methodology.gsc_impressions: docs/audit-worklist-v2.json gsc_top_pages aggregated per final article; null = no GSC row

tier_1_priority_order_note: priority = gsc_impressions DESC (null last) -> affected_words_pct DESC -> inbound_internal_links DESC -> slug ASC
